scientific_question: Y030 reduced churn on a newly keyed geometry. Under abrupt pre-registered displacement changes, is previous assignment memory still legal and does it justify search, read, and write costs?
preregistration: Freeze displacement schedule, utility weights, source-family, two policies, numerical cohort, all negative outcomes before first experiment. Never tune cost weight or geometry from results.
population: Reuse exact frozen Y030 keyed 16-cell/16-key/7-active/9-inactive-cache generator, with new seeds 48-55 and independent keyed signatures. Eight episodes per seed. Add current-episode circular home displacement to all neighborhood locations, modulo16.
arms: sham: writes identical max-nine slot cache but never reads
retained: writes identical cache and reads current active-key stored assignments, uses only legal under current geometry
utility: Each policy total cost = search_recursive_calls*1 + memory_writes*1 + attempted_cache_reads*1 + assignment_churn*w; preregister w=1,3,10 simultaneously and publish all, not cherry-pick. Sham attempts=0; retained counts every lookup of active keys currently present in cache even if now illegal.
primary: Per-seed and total churn, legal preference counts, matching cardinalities, memory occupancy/writes parity, recursive matching calls, and net cost at all 3 frozen churn weights.
classification: If cardinality deviates from independent exhaustive Hall oracle or no eight unique full geometry signatures, INVALID. Else CONSISTENT_NET_GAIN only if net cost advantage positive on all four heldout seeds for all weights; NET_HARM if all three aggregate differences negative; otherwise TRADEOFF_OR_MIXED. All outcomes legitimate.
controls: No evaluator history passed to policies, no oracle or future displacements in matching decisions, exact prior Y030 source hash pinned, bounded retained memory and identical write/occupancy, no retries, one full regression.
claim_limit: Synthetic episodic cache-value study; utility weights illustrative, no cognitive-regeneration or real-world learning claims; no accepted-ref mutation.
